B_C05.interpretation: Observed inconsistency of local and historical views, not a trusted change-point of physical calibration. Separation uses terminal observation, not an unrecorded exact historical-fetch time. No continuous live monitoring is assumed.
B_C05.fetch_bracket_semantics: Local interval enclosing query according to recorded event order and read-only source inspection; not exact fetch time or provider propagation lag. Bound units have generic unit events; no unit_bound event exists.
B_C05.query_time_dependence_not_identified: Different running timestamps were queried at different times. No repeated fixed-timestamp lookup or physical ground truth; observed label inconsistency alone does not identify dependence on query time.

B_C09.interpretation: Elapsed accepted-to-observed-cancellation time; provider running/finished timestamps absent, so do not call it measured queue time.

clock_partition_interpretation: Arithmetic partitions only. Residual includes local work, communication, observation and unmatched clock semantics, not identified client overhead. Subtracting queue is not a no-queue counterfactual.
